reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one that names the lab and puts the batch report where I can check it. At $24.99 for the first box that is about 83 cents a day, so I would try one box before the launch price ends.
objection: I can only see that a report exists, I have not read it. If the lab is a name nobody knows, it is still just marketing. Also I do not know if 200 mg is the right amount for me.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch showed the real magnesium amount and it did not match the box, or I could not open it before paying, I would pass.
